payload.summary: SQLite-based task-lock system to prevent multi-session agent collisions. New coordination.db + 4 MCP tools (task_claim, task_heartbeat, task_release, task_list_held). 3-phase rollout: Phase 1 = DB + tools only (ship now), Phase 2 = cowork-slot locking, Phase 3 = sprint-task + dashboard-row locking.
